scientific_integrity: Analytic infinite-family proof and independently replayable small-instance checks. Earlier specialized code-theoretic observability literature remains a historical-priority risk. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Sharp only among affine \(m\)-dimensional absorbing sets on \(Q_{2^m-1}\) for \(m\ge3\), with uniform hopping and strictly positive sink rates; does not classify all maximizers, finite-time decay or unrestricted trap placements.
title: Optimal coherent absorption by binary simplex-code traps on hypercubes
